svg.title: Black Square with Red
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Black upper-right square joined at side to smaller red lower-left square. Empty upper-left and lower-right areas are transparent wall, not white canvas. Actual colour plate PDF96; caption isPDF95. Historical outer ratio91¾/78in. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://assets.moma.org/documents/moma_catalogue_2535_300299040.pdf#page=96; catalogue record moma1973-pdf95-caption1; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
